coverage_override.reason: Normal/Special Summon clones implement one printed trigger; each equip sentence remains one effect, and the Fusion Summon plus its material handling is one effect.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can equip 1 "Red-Eyes" monster from your hand or GY to it.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_SUMMON_SUCCESS and EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS clones share id, require Spell/Trap Zone capacity, select a Red-Eyes monster from hand or Necrovalley-valid GY, and equip it to this face-up card with an equip limit.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Red-Eyes effect equips a monster from the GY with Duel.Equip and installs a recipient-specific EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT.

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 Dragon, Fiend, or Warrior Fusion Monster by using Monster Cards from your hand or field.
effects.lua_implementation: A Main Phase EVENT_FREE_CHAIN Quick Effect now builds the ordinary Duel.GetFusionMaterial group and merges face-up original Monster Cards in the controller's Spell/Trap Zone that can be Fusion Material, can be sent to the GY, and are not immune. It filters Dragon/Warrior/Fiend Fusions, selects material, sends it with REASON_EFFECT+REASON_MATERIAL+REASON_FUSION, Special Summons with SUMMON_TYPE_FUSION, completes the procedure, and retains Chain Material support.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Fusion effect merges eligible face-up original Monster Cards from LOCATION_SZONE into Duel.GetFusionMaterial before CheckFusionMaterial and SelectFusionMaterial.
Official monster Quick/activated Fusion pattern selects hand/field material, sends it with Fusion-material reasons, Special Summons, and completes the procedure.

effects.issue: Fixed: face-up Monster Cards in the controller's Spell/Trap Zone are now included in the printed hand-or-field material pool using Omega's Vision Fusion extra-material pattern.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is sent to the GY as Fusion Material: You can target 1 "Red-Eyes" monster you control; equip this card to it.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed EVENT_TO_GRAVE trigger requires REASON_MATERIAL and REASON_FUSION, targets a face-up controlled Red-Eyes monster, validates Necrovalley and Spell/Trap capacity, and equips this GY card with an equip limit under id+200.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Red-Eyes operation targets a recipient, equips a monster from the GY, and registers EFFECT_EQUIP_LIMIT.
